improvements.rationale: Search engines display meta descriptions in results, directly impacting click-through rates. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, and Facebook—critical for a B2B audience. Including the free trial offer and key features (Claude-powered, voice chat, instant answers) differentiates Gideon and encourages clicks. Currently missing these tags means search and social previews default to generic or incomplete text, reducing conversions from organic and referral traffic.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a professional workspace built for business owners and traders. Try 3 free searches — no card required."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately introduces Gideon by name, establishing brand identity while clearly communicating what the product is. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) and targets the specific audience (business owners and traders). Ending with the free trial offer and 'no card required' reduces friction and encourages immediate engagement without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue accessing unlimited AI-powered trade and business support. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, billed monthly—or save 30 percent with an annual plan. As a member, you'll unlock unlimited queries, voice chat, and your own dedicated workspace.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common conversion barrier—understanding what happens at the paywall moment. It reassures prospects that the free trial is genuine, clearly explains pricing without pressure, and highlights the value unlocked by membership. Transparency at this stage builds trust and reduces abandonment.
